title: Bulk delete and account deletion
pr_description: Adds delete_expenses_bulk() for multi-select delete in the UI and delete_account() for GDPR-style full account removal.

defects.anchor: f"DELETE FROM expenses WHERE id IN ({placeholders})",
defects.description: The bulk delete never filters by user_id, so any authenticated user can delete any other user's expenses by guessing ids (IDOR / broken object-level authorization). Compare delete_expense(), which scopes by owner.

The users row is deleted first while expenses and tokens still reference it. With PRAGMA foreign_keys ON (set in db.py) the first DELETE raises IntegrityError and account deletion always fails; children must be deleted before the parent or in one transaction.
